form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Coons (for himself, Mr. Gardner, Mrs. Gillibrand, Mr. Tillis, Ms. Hassan, Mr. Peters, Mr. Moran, and Mr. Rubio) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation

form.official-title: To amend the National Institute of Standards and Technology Act to improve the Network for Manufacturing Innovation Program, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Global Leadership in Advanced Manufacturing Act of 2019.

section.header: Improvements to Network for Manufacturing Innovation Program

subsection.text: Subsection (c) of section 34 of the National Institute of Standards and Technology Act (15 U.S.C. 278s) is amended—

paragraph.text: in subparagraphs (B) and (C)(i) of paragraph (1), by striking and tool both places it appears and inserting tool development for microelectronics, food manufacturing, superconductors, advanced battery technologies, robotics, advanced sensors, quantum information science, supply chain water optimization, and aeronautics and advanced materials;
in paragraph (2)(D), by striking and minority and inserting , minority, and veteran; and
in paragraph (3)(A), by striking , but such and all that follows through under subsection (d).

subsection.header: Financial assistance To establish and support centers for manufacturing innovation
subsection.text: Subsection (d) of such section is amended—

subparagraph.text: in subparagraph (C)—

clause.text: in clause (i), by striking ; and and inserting a semicolon;

subclause.text: by inserting , including appropriate measures for assessing the effectiveness of the activities funded with regards to the center's success in advancing the current state of the applicable advanced manufacturing technology area such as technology readiness level and manufacturing readiness level, after measures; and
by striking the period at the end; and

clause.text: by adding at the end the following:
establish standards for the performance of centers for manufacturing innovation that are based on the measures developed under clause (ii); and

for each center for manufacturing innovation supported by the award, if any, once every 5 years, conduct an assessment of the center to confirm whether the performance of the center is meeting the standards for performance established under clause (iii).

subparagraph.text: in subparagraph (D), by inserting , including the Department of Agriculture, the Department of Defense, the Department of Education, the Department of Energy, the Department of Labor, the Food and Drug Administration, the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, the National Institutes of Health, and the National Science Foundation after manufacturing; and
in subparagraph (E)—

clause.text: in clause (ii), by striking without the need for long-term Federal funding;
in clause (v), by inserting and to improve the domestic supply chain after technologies; and
in clause (ix), by inserting industrial, research, entrepreneurship, and other after leverage the;

subparagraph.text: by striking subparagraph (A) and inserting the following:

No award of financial assistance may be made under paragraph (1) to support a center for manufacturing innovation that the Secretary finds under paragraph (4)(C) does not meet the standards for performance established under paragraph (4)(C)(iii).
in subparagraph (B)—

clause.text: in the first sentence, by striking large capital facilities or equipment purchases and inserting large capital facilities, equipment purchases, workforce development, or general operations; and
by striking the second sentence; and

subparagraph.text: by striking subparagraph (C); and

paragraph.text: by adding at the end the following:
Financial assistance awarded under paragraph (1) may be used—

subparagraph.text: for the purposes described in such paragraph; or
to carry out Program-wide activities directed by the Secretary, such as activities targeting workforce development.

subsection.text: Subsection (e)(2) of such section is amended—

paragraph.text: by amending subparagraph (A) to read as follows:

subparagraph.text: To the extent provided for in advance by appropriations Acts, the Secretary may use amounts appropriated to the Institute for Industrial Technical Services account to carry out this section as follows:

clause.text: For each of the fiscal years 2015 through 2019, an amount not to exceed $5,000,000.
For each of fiscal years 2020 through 2030, such amounts as may be necessary to carry out this section.

paragraph.text: in subparagraph (B), by striking through 2024 and inserting through 2019.

subsection.text: Subsection (f) of such section is amended—

subparagraph.text: in subparagraph (B)—

clause.text: by inserting coordinate with and, as appropriate, before enter; and

by inserting including the Department of Agriculture, the Department of Defense, the Department of Education, the Department of Energy, the Department of Labor, the Food and Drug Administration, the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, the National Institutes of Health, and the National Science Foundation, after manufacturing,;

subparagraph.text: in subparagraph (E), by striking ; and and inserting a semicolon;
by redesignating subparagraph (F) as subparagraph (J); and
by inserting after subparagraph (E) the following:
to carry out pilot programs in collaboration with the centers for manufacturing innovation such as a laboratory-embedded entrepreneurship program;
to provide support services and funding as necessary to promote workforce development activities;
to coordinate with centers for manufacturing innovation to develop best practices for the membership agreements and coordination of similar project solicitations;

to collaborate with the Department of Labor, the Department of Education, industry, career and technical education schools, local community colleges, universities, and labor organizations to provide input for the development of national certifications for advanced manufacturing workforce skills in the technology areas of the centers for manufacturing innovation; and

paragraph.text: in paragraph (3), by inserting State and local governments, after community colleges,; and

subparagraph.text: by striking The Secretary and inserting the following:
The Secretary
by adding at the end the following:

clause.text: The Secretary may provide financial assistance to a manufacturing extension center established as part of the Hollings Manufacturing Extension Partnership to detail a liaison of the center to a center for manufacturing innovation to facilitate the support by the Partnership of at least the following:

subclause.text: Cybersecurity awareness and support services for small- and medium-sized manufacturers.
Technology transfer for small and medium-sized manufacturers.

clause.text: Selection of a liaison under this subparagraph shall be made in coordination with the applicable center for manufacturing innovation.

subsection.text: Subsection (g) of such section is amended—

paragraph.text: in paragraph (2)(A), by striking December 31, 2024 and inserting December 31, 2030; and

subparagraph.text: in subparagraph (A)—

clause.text: by striking 2 years and inserting 3 years; and

subparagraph.text: in subparagraph (B), by striking December 31, 2024 and inserting December 31, 2030.

subsection.text: Subject to the availability of appropriations, the Secretary of Commerce shall increase the number of centers for manufacturing innovation that participate in the Network for Manufacturing Innovation Program.
